lessons.trigger_condition: Verified unknown TCGs could be auto-seeded into WATCH, but auto-created WATCH rows had no bounded retirement lifecycle and could permanently consume the 64-row registry capacity after their official and market evidence disappeared. Fresh October 2026 evidence also identified Elestrals TCG as an active market category with current organized play, a new set, independent secondary-market depth and serialized-card collectibility.
lessons.prevention_rule: Retire only runtime auto-seeded WATCH rows after at least 180 days without fresh verified official or marketplace activity. Never auto-delete manually curated WATCH rows. Reclaim retired capacity before admitting new unknown candidates. Keep new-game grading disabled until separate calibration. Promote market categories only from fresh official plus independent market evidence, minimum catalog depth and activation score gates; never infer profit or price direction.

lessons.safety_boundary: This lesson adds bounded registry lifecycle management and a verified market-surface category. It does not guarantee profit, infer future price direction, fabricate stock, auto-enable non-core grading, change the 17→12→18 neural architecture, weaken CI, or claim physical Lenovo deployment.
